cells.data: Versioned encoded value, created/fresh/stale timestamps; optional stampede lock token separate key
cells.retention: TTL per key; independent evictable instance allowed. Key digest includes principal/site/language where response private.

cells.data: Hash payload/version/expiry; atomic CAS or tombstone in same slot
cells.retention: TTL <= session expiry; tombstone spans max request lifetime after logout; noeviction preferred, outage fails closed.

cells.data: Token-bucket tokens/refill timestamp via Lua and Redis TIME; no cross-slot shared transaction
cells.retention: TTL covers refill window; fail-closed security default with explicit policy override only.

cells.data: Redis Stream per queue priority bucket; consumer groups/pending list; stable task ID in payload
cells.retention: Never trim entries with pending deliveries; ack terminal before deletion; queue depth quotas; noeviction + persistence configuration required.

cells.data: Hash(task-id) modulo 64 fixed partitions; state/fence/lease/result/tombstone and pending-intent index updated in same script/slot
cells.retention: Full result 24h default; tombstone >=7d; active tasks/intents retained. Relay polls all 64 known indexes; no cross-slot index publication gap.

cells.data: Hash(workflow-id) modulo 64; DAG/member outcomes/callback claim and partition intent index atomic in one slot
cells.retention: Retain until members terminal plus replay horizon; callback delivery and cleanup tracked; fixed partition changes require drain/reconciliation migration.

cells.data: Due sorted set, schedule payload/version, lease and stable occurrence/fire intent in same slot
cells.retention: Partitioned fixed shard count configured; migration between partitions requires drain/reconcile; no one gigantic global cluster transaction.

cells.data: Revocation intent and expiry; worker verifies before start and on heartbeat
cells.retention: Retention covers task expiry/replay; revoke is not proof process stopped; durable task state records acknowledgment.

cells.data: Bounded monitoring stream; safe progress and lifecycle events
cells.retention: Trimming allowed for monitor events; never authoritative for result/chord state. Independent consumer positions.

cells.data: Original message reference, bounded safe envelope, decode error code, first seen and source receipt
cells.retention: Persist quarantine before ack; authorized inspect/replay/remove commands; secret-redacted display; operator retention with backup export optional.

cells.data: Owner token/fence/expiry; renew and release check token
cells.retention: No correctness based on a lock alone: target writes verify fence or idempotency; Redis failover can lose unreplicated lock/state.

summary: Proposed contract for architecture review; not implemented.
title: Redis keys, partitions and retention
